source_binding: Inherit all previous source and acceptance-output SHA256/size descriptors; explicitly map 15 direct data/control files. Bind schemas, all three original fit IDs, fixed denominator/slices, original control aggregates, train-only costs, implementation, independent oracle, tests and environment. Hash before and after one run.
prepare: Synthetic accepted-format CSV/JSONL cases only, full pipeline and complete independent readback, then byte/metadata source binding and freeze. No real data CSV/JSONL semantic parse, K1 index, query ranking, metrics or bootstrap; no cost rerun.
loader: Role-filter before item/target decoding. Train-only fit, warmup/train/validation causal history, validation-labelled queries only. Complete C1 train lineage and support equality. Original P0 rank/metric/slice files cross-checked against C1 and D1 stored copies. Copy original three-arm values; no control refit/rerank.
oracle: Separate raw CSV/JSONL parser with SQL DISTINCT train memberships and history; complete session/posting/lineage/fit readback; EVERY train session and EVERY causal candidate for EVERY query, exact Fraction ordering/votes. Independently join current and next basket, history and target; full nested four-arm row, Decimal/Fraction metrics, all fixed slices/diagnostics/aggregates and all 2000 Counter/struct bootstrap draws. No production K1/loader/evaluator imports, no sampling.
lifecycle: Absent namespace exclusively created once. Started marker before model work. Any failure, interruption or resource excess preserves partial artifacts and blocks replay; complete reentry verifies bytes only. No CLI source/window/k/sample/budget/role override. No final/test mode or test-use journal.
checkpoints: Frozen cooperative 0.5s resource monitor during source hashing, data rows, fit, queries, index/output loops, full oracle session/candidate loops, bootstrap and SQLite VM steps; phase checks around noninterruptible Python sorts. Sampled limits are not OS hard limits. Primary index released before independent reconstruction.

output_schema.nested_schema: Exact frozen K1 core/evaluator output fields; oracle rejects missing, extra or altered nested fields. Fit audit and aggregates retain implementation-v1 shape. Complete artifacts are SHA-bound.

interpretation: Entry acceptance on synthetic files is not real validation acceptance, runtime feasibility, recommendation performance or final model selection. P0/C1/D1 exposure remains disclosed; future K1-C1 interval is development evidence only.
